text:
Ana (People Ops): dropping a note after today's calibration + exporter preflight discussion. TL;DR: we're formalizing a 3-step preflight for any ATS exporter change and adding a short interviewer-training slide about "what breaks when headers move".
Jess: +1. the exporter change last month revealed ops blindspots. Having a short checklist will help reduce emergency fixes.
Priya: proposed 3-step preflight (brief): 1) schema diff (automated) + human review, 2) sandbox export test (People Ops runs importer dry-run), 3) deploy flag + post-deploy smoke-checks (alerts for >5 mapping warnings).
export-team-bot: New schema-diff report available: https://ci.internal/redwood/exports/schema-diff/2026-03-18 (shows column additions: preferred_location, region_pref, role_label).
Marco (People Ops): can we add one more item: update the "interviewer impact" note in the release PR (one sentence saying "affects interviewer fields: role, timezone, scorecard_id") so reviewers actually see it?
Leah (Hiring): as a hiring manager, I just want a quick way to know if my interviewers need action. Could the export PR include an automatic sample of 10 random rows so we can eyeball?
devex-bot: Feature request logged: ID DEVEX-514. Auto-sample of 10 rows will be added to export PR template.
Jess: for training slide: short doc blurb + 2 screenshots: 1) exporter header example, 2) importer preview with column shift. I'll draft and post.
Priya: also adding a tiny checklist for interviewers: when you get a calendar failure check 1) role id present (IR-*), 2) timezone present, 3) scorecard assigned. If any missing, file a ticket with the CSV row id.
Ana (People Ops): sample CSV snippet we can include in training (redacted):
```
email,first,last,role,timezone,scorecard_id
sam@redwood.com,Sam,Chen,onsite_engineer,UTC-07,SC-201
mia@redwood.com,Mia,Patel,onsite_pm,UTC+01,SC-201
```
Jess: force-memo to release owners: please run `./tools/ats_preflight --export-id $PR_NUMBER` before merging. It performs header validation + dry-run importer and posts a short report to the PR.
export-team-bot: preflight tool docs: https://internal-docs/exports/ats-preflight (auth required).
Marco (People Ops): timeline: Jess will post training slide by EOD Friday, Priya will add runbook checks and Slack alert, devex will land PR template change in next sprint, and export team will adopt preflight tool.
Leah (Hiring): will share the 1-pager for hiring managers so they know how to interpret alerts.
Ana (People Ops): great — once the training slide and PR template are live we'll run a 15-min cross-team sync next Wednesday. Invite going out from #calendar. :thumbsup:
Jess: small ask: can we include one short sample command in the slide for folks who want to run a local dry-run? propose:
```
./scripts/ats_importer --dry-run --file sample_export.csv --check-headers
```
Priya: love that. Also adding an automated Slack alert if importer sees header mismatches in prod > 0.5% of rows per job.
devex-bot: Alert rule proposed: Importer:HeaderMismatchRate > 0.005 -> #people-ops + #eng-platform.
Ana (People Ops): thanks team. We'll treat this as a small process rollout (no emergency). I'll add notes to interviewer-training and tag the training channel when live.
Leah (Hiring): thank you  these small steps will save a lot of calendar chaos. :party_parrot:
